mechanical.description: Mechanical, low-judgment work with an obvious outcome: rename a symbol, fix a typo, bump a version, reformat, move a file, update an import, find-and-replace, simple lookups or listing things.

middle.description: Well-specified, self-contained coding with a clear spec and little ambiguity: implement one function or file, write tests to a precise description, scaffold boilerplate, a mechanical multi-file refactor.
middle.message: Router: MIDDLE tier ({reason}). Do not spawn a subagent. Invoke the `junie-with-qwen` skill with this task, then review Junie's diff before trusting it. If this is misrouted, re-issue the Agent call with [route:opus] in the prompt.

intelligent.description: Needs real judgment or reasoning: architecture or design decisions, trade-offs, root-cause debugging, code review, security analysis, ambiguous requirements, explaining why something behaves as it does.

long_run.description: Long-running, multi-step implementation work: build a whole feature end to end, a migration or change across the codebase, many files and many steps, work that takes a long time to complete.
